findings.evidence: Before terminal materialization the transaction validates Skill-chain Asset identity/hash and all anchors, requires an authoritative receipt reader, and calls the existing verify_skill_chain semantic verifier for receipt closure and canonical chain_hash. A sole wrong-chain-hash drift returns RESULT_CONTRACT_MISMATCH with unchanged authority state.

Complete replay dispatches by persisted snapshot profile. Full RunSnapshot uses verify_snapshot; broker-child binding validates exact Snapshot bytes, creation/record/invoke authority and reuses verify_child_snapshot_binding. Exact child replay returns equal result and byte-equivalent frame with unchanged SQLite serialization and Asset set, while identity/receipt/package drift remains fail-closed.
